raw_segments.text: But just as Daniel was about to go Natásha came in with rapid steps, not having done up her hair or finished dressing and with her old nurse's big shawl wrapped round her.
Pétya ran in at the same time.
Having finished his inquiries and extorted from Daniel an opinion that the hounds were fit,
Daniel himself wished to go hunting, Nicholas ordered the horses to be saddled.
But just as Daniel was about to go Natásha came in with rapid steps,
not having done up her hair or finished dressing and with her old nurses big shawl wrapped round her.
Pétya ran in at the same time.
